name: delphi-cross-socket
description: Delphi cross-platform async socket library (IOCP/epoll/kqueue) with HTTP server and OpenSSL 3.x support. Fork of winddriver/Delphi-Cross-Socket — adds a Boss manifest, the vendored CnPack subset, the HEAD resend-loop fix (FIX-HEAD-LOOP-1/2, issue #203) and SetCipherList as a deprecated delegation to SetTls12CipherSuites.
